description: The kinds of age-restricted product a catalogue version 2 offer's age_restricted names (docs/protocol/network.md §4.18, catalogue version 2): each kind's label in five languages, what it covers, and whether a network lists it (network). The minimum age is never here: the business sets it for each product (min_age, and by_country where it sells), checked by ID at handover, and this list keeps no table of what any law says. Other spellings a reader takes as the kind are its also (vape is tobacco_nicotine, firearms is weapons). A kind whose network is off is kept off networks at product level, ID check or not: a reader holds every offer of that kind and lists the business's other products as before. A kind that is none of these, nor any of their also spellings, is held too (age_kind_unknown) until the business picks one: knives are blades or weapons, and the business says which. A kind is never removed or renamed, a spelling never moves to another kind, and a kind's network never moves from off to listed without a new version of this file. A reader that meets a kind a later version of this file adds holds it until it reads that version.

kinds.covers: Beer, wine, cider, spirits and other drinks with alcohol in them.
Cigarettes, cigars, rolling and pipe tobacco, e-cigarettes and vapes with their refills, heated tobacco and nicotine pouches.
Cannabis, and products made from it that contain THC. Not hemp seeds, hemp oil, hemp protein or other hemp foods.
Firearms and their parts, ammunition, air guns, crossbows, swords, knives sold as weapons and other offensive weapons.
Kitchen, craft and pocket knives, razor blades, axes and other tools with a blade, sold as tools.
Fireworks, sparklers, party poppers and other pyrotechnics.
Solvents, lighter gas and fluid, spray paint and corrosive cleaners.
Drinks high in caffeine sold as energy drinks.

kinds.covers: Films, video games and other media with an age rating.
Lottery tickets, scratchcards and other games of chance.
Adult content and products sold to adults only.
Medicines sold without a prescription that are sold only above an age. Never a prescription-only medicine.
Anything else the business sells only above an age.
